summary: Nūr Protocol iteration 3 — voice (TTS/STT) + photo consultation flow validated end-to-end. BACKEND: 14/14 pytest cases pass (new file /app/backend/tests/test_voice_photo.py). Covered: POST /api/tts returns {path:/api/tts/<64hex>.mp3,key}, GET of that path returns audio/mpeg >1 KB, 2nd identical POST returns the same key (cache hit), empty text → 400 empty_text, GET /api/tts/not-hex.mp3 → 400 bad_key, GET /api/tts/<unknown 64-hex>.mp3 → 404; POST /api/transcribe with <2 KB blob → {text:'',reason:'too_short'}, real mp3 generated via /api/tts round-trips to a non-empty French transcription (contains 'Sophie' / 'peau'), .foo extension tolerated; POST /api/users/{id}/chat with history + lang=fr reaches ask_photo=true within 5 turns and the [PHOTO] marker NEVER leaks into reply (verified across 2 independent runs), chat with photo_base64 (nur-avatar.png b64) returns an observation + LED plan with no brand name (CeraVe/COSRX/La Roche-Posay/Nivea/L'Oréal/Clinique/Estée absent) and no markdown (** or #), off-topic ('bitcoin') politely refused via the LLM (contains 'Skincoach'/'rituel'/'accompagne'), 'politique' triggers the keyword blocklist → blocked=true + canned refusal, empty message and >1000 chars both → 400 invalid_message_length. FRONTEND (/coach, mobile viewport 390x844, user injected via localStorage with NUR-CREATOR + intake seeded): coach-start visible → tap sends message → typing dots → assistant bubble with coach-speak-* button appears; tapping Listen/Écouter triggers exactly 1 POST /api/tts call with no JS error (no audio actually plays on preview but the pipeline is clean); coach-input + coach-send empile correctly; coach-mic on web shows coach-hint 'The microphone is unavailable right now.' without crash; after ~4 substantive French turns coach-photo-card appears with coach-open-camera and coach-photo-later testIDs — the [PHOTO] marker never shows in the DOM; tapping coach-photo-later makes the card disappear and sends the follow-up message. Dark theme preserved (black bg + gold accents). The web preview locale auto-switched to EN (detected by browser) — behaviour expected per prompt; FR dictionary verified in the backend tests. No new deprecated-package / RN red-screen issues. Known RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents / useNativeDriver) persist from iteration 1 — carried over, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Still logged: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — carried over from iteration 1, non-blocking on native. Reference: multiple StyleSheets using shadow* in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (theme.shadow.*).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — one occurrence spotted in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/coach.tsx:529 (<View ... pointerEvents="none">).

action_items: No blocker. Optional cleanup: migrate theme.shadow.* styles to boxShadow and the single pointerEvents prop in coach.tsx:529 to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web warnings (carried over from iteration 1).

Nice-to-have: the OpenAI STT path uses model 'gpt-4o-mini-transcribe' (per server.py) while the problem statement mentions tts-1 + nova (TTS) — confirmed consistent for TTS; STT model choice is not a bug but worth noting if a model switch was requested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — _is_blocked uses substring match on short keywords (e.g. 'ignore', 'nu', 'dieu'), but the length guard 'len(k) > 3' already filters 'nu'/'sex'. Still, 'ignore' will match benign phrases like 'je ne peux pas ignorer…' — consider word-boundary regex to reduce false positives.

server.py:1437 — [PHOTO] marker is replaced on the server BEFORE being returned, which is correct. Confirmed via UI DOM scan: marker never leaks to the client. Keep this invariant covered by regression tests on every prompt-template tweak.

server.py:1206 — TTS_DIR is tempfile.gettempdir()/nur_tts: on container restart the cache is wiped. For prod, consider mounting a durable volume or S3-ish bucket to keep audio replays cheap for repeat visitors.
voice.ts — speak() creates a new AudioPlayer per call but only one 'speaker' slot. If a user double-taps Listen fast, the first player is remove()'d via stopSpeaking() — covered. Good.
coach.tsx is 679 lines, borderline for a single-file screen. Audio recording logic (armRecorder/startListening/stopListening/metering effect) could move to a useVoiceInput hook to drop ~120 lines.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 coach flow checks: start, speak, send, text, mic hint, photo-card, photo-later)

seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh user via POST /api/activate {activation_code:'NUR-CREATOR'} (partner multi-use code) and seeds a minimal intake (mixte/pores+ternissement/25-34) so the ask_photo marker is reachable within 3-5 turns. No persistent fixture pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /coach screen is reachable without onboarding as long as localStorage['nur.user_id'] is set — use `fetch('/api/activate', ...)` from inside page.evaluate() to bypass the Kubernetes WAF (urllib from the shell gets 403 Forbidden from the ingress on direct POST). Seed the intake too, otherwise the LLM asks 4-5 generic questions before even getting to the pore/radiance thread, which can push ask_photo past the 6-turn budget and the test times out. The TTS endpoint caches by sha256(text|voice|speed|model|mp3) so the second identical request is free — leverage this to speed up regression suites. Transcribe accepts .m4a/.mp3/.mp4/.mpeg/.mpga/.wav/.webm; anything else is coerced to .m4a before sending to OpenAI. On web the microphone is unavailable (handled gracefully via coach-hint). Browser locale may flip the UI to EN — the French backend prompt is independent of frontend locale, so backend tests always pass in FR.
